# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 46

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 046
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "eyes should be downcast" vs. "need to look up to them"

**Verse:** v.1
**LOGOS:** "his eyes should be downcast"
**PNEUMA:** "John would need to look up to them"
**Issue:** The Coptic eye-idiom (*penbal nehse*) = his eyes should/need not be lowered. LOGOS renders the physical lowering; PNEUMA renders the spatial "looking up." LOGOS preserves the idiom more precisely.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "His eyes should be downcast" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "surpass" vs. "be greater than"

**Verse:** v.2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "will surpass John"
**PNEUMA:** "will be greater than John"
**Issue:** *Jose* = to be higher, surpass, exceed. Both renderings work; "surpass" is more dynamic.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Surpass John" retained.

---
